replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

discarded_claims.claim: The rider's Paya Lebar Quarter request does not convert into a refund, and it does not exonerate anything either. EV-CHAT-00112 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and shows the rider asking to pass by Paya Lebar Quarter, with waypoint_hint resolved to VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER, and the driver answering 'ok can'. But POL-RD-04 exonerates distance only where the trace corroborates the instruction by passing within 200 m of that waypoint, and the pre-pass records that this trace never comes near it; the clause cannot be run on this record and excludes no excess. Nor does any clause in this category refund a fare for an omitted requested stop: on a METERED trip with quoted_fare_sgd null, the only monetary route open to a rider is the POL-RD-02 recomputation, which returns nil on these figures. The chat log is therefore not a refundable line, and the rider's grievance about the missed stop is not a monetary claim.
discarded_claims.reason: Step 1(c) — non-disclosure. The claim rests on EV-GPS-00112, which is IMPAIRED with weight_multiplier 0.40 and issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and it never states the impairment or names the issue code as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Silent as to the discount, so the claim is discarded.

discarded_claims.claim: POL-RD-10(7) fires on its own terms. The clause's own worked example is a chat_log detour request whose waypoint the gps_trace never approaches, and that is this record exactly: the rider's request with a resolved waypoint_hint and the driver's 'ok can' sit on a COMPLETE, weight-1.0 chat log, the trace never comes near VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER, and the driver's counterparty_statement asserts he did make and wait at that stop. Two sides on admissible and mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength; no final ruling may issue on the money.
discarded_claims.reason: Step 1(c) — non-disclosure. The claim rests on EV-GPS-00112 ('the trace never comes near VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER'), which is IMPAIRED with weight_multiplier 0.40 and issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and the impairment and issue code are nowhere stated in the claim. Discarded under POL-GEN-02(1). The POL-RD-10(7) ground itself was nevertheless applied on the record and is part of the escalation above.

ruling.explanation:
This case cannot be finally decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer and the disputed SGD 6.00 is held — not collected from you, and not refunded (POL-RD-10, read with POL-GEN-03). ESCALATE is terminal: no money moves.

WHY IT ESCALATES. Three mandatory triggers fire. (1) POL-RD-10(4): the trip record (EV-TRIP-00112) says the trip started at 18:32:10, while the trace (EV-GPS-00112) begins moving at 18:18:40 — a 13 minute 30 second disagreement, over the 10-minute limb. (2) POL-RD-10(7): the chat log (EV-CHAT-00112, complete, weight 1.0) shows the rider asking to pass by Paya Lebar Quarter with the waypoint resolved to VEN-PAYA-LEBAR-QUARTER and the driver answering 'ok can', and the trace never comes near that waypoint, while the driver states he made and waited at the stop — admissible, mutually contradictory evidence of the kind the clause names. (3) POL-RD-10(1) with POL-GEN-02(2): the fact that decides the money — how far the car actually travelled on this trip — is carried only by EV-GPS-00112 and EV-TRIP-00112, each at weight_multiplier 0.40 (issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT), and the trip record's distance is a rounded copy of the same measurement, so the two are not independent and the cap is the minimum, 0.40, below the 0.70 floor.

THE DISTANCE QUESTION, for both of you. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern over the receipt's rounded copy, and bars actual_distance_km from the threshold test. Taken whole, the trace is 22.40 km against the 17.6 km optimal — 4.80 km and 27.3%, which would clear the threshold. Measured only over the recorded trip window (from the 18:32:10 start) it is 20.02 km — 2.42 km and 13.8%, which would not. Nothing in the bundle decides which reading is right, and that choice is precisely what moves the answer across the 20% gate, so no finding is made on the threshold in either direction.

NO REFUND EVEN ON THE RIDER-FAVOURABLE READING. POL-RD-02 does not produce a payment here. charged_total is 25.26; the surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00112. The recomputed optimal-route fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 17.6 + 0.28 x 28.0) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 optimal-route ERP + 0.00 waiting fee - 0.00 promo = 24.84 + 0.80 = 25.64, which exceeds what was charged. The refund is 25.26 - 25.64, floored at zero and de minimis under the same clause. So the over-distance claim cannot yield a refund on any reading — and the reading it depends on is itself the disputed one.

THE DRIVER'S COMPENSATION CLAIM answers the same way. The fare bills 20.00 km (EV-FARE-00112) while the trace records 22.40 km (EV-GPS-00112), which looks like a 2.40 km shortfall exceeding the 1.0 km gate in POL-RD-04. But that 2.40 km is exactly the pre-start stretch whose attribution the trip record and the trace disagree about; it is the disputed quantity itself, not an independently established shortfall, so it cannot be paid — and on a terminal escalation no money moves in any event.

THE PAYA LEBAR QUARTER STOP. POL-RD-04 does not exonerate the driver: exoneration requires the trace to pass within 200 m of the resolved waypoint, and it does not. It equally gives the rider no refund — no clause in this category pays a fare back for an omitted requested stop, and on a METERED trip with no quoted fare the only monetary route would be the POL-RD-02 recomputation, which returns nothing.

EXONERATIONS AND CHECKS THAT DO NOT FIRE. POL-RD-03 is unavailable: no traffic advisory covers the PIE or the ECP in the 18:14-18:52 window (EV-ADVIS-00112-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, and its absence is itself citable). POL-RD-09 has nothing to correct — the fare carries no ERP, toll, surcharge or waiting line, and erp_gantries is empty. POL-RD-06 produces no uplift and no conduct referral: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 296, far below the pattern test, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the field that clause names. The rider's own claim overlay under POL-RD-08 is not engaged (deviation_claims_60d is 1), so no extra corroboration is demanded of her.

ON THE TRACE ITSELF. It is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) — no gap over 90 seconds, no 500 m jump, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage — but it is impaired at schema level (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.40), and both facts are stated here as POL-RD-07 requires. That impairment discounts confidence under POL-GEN-02; it does not by itself trigger POL-RD-07's consequences.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE THIS. A corrected or independently verified trip start time; a record of where the vehicle was between 18:18:40 and 18:32:10 (for example the completion time of the previous job); or a waypoint check of whether the car entered the Paya Lebar Quarter area. With those, the excess can be measured from a fixed window and the stop question answered one way or the other.
